title: Therapeutic potential of spinacetin against cadmium-exacerbated hepatic ischemia/reperfusion injury via regulating AMPK/SIRT1/PGC-1alpha and NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Bibi, Aqsa; Zhang, Hong-Xing; Hayat, Muhammad Faisal; Alzahrani, Khalid J; Alsharif, Khalaf F; Alzahrani, Fuad M
journal: Journal of trace elements in medicine and biology : organ of the Society for Minerals and Trace Elements (GMS)
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Spinacetin对镉加剧肝缺血再灌注损伤的保护作用，涉及AMPK/SIRT1/NF-kB通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅分子对接辅助验证，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cadmium (Cd) is a potent environmental toxicant that affect different body organs including the liver. Spinacetin (SPI) is a plant-derived polyphenolic compound with diverse biological activities. OBJECTIVE: The current investigation assessed the palliative potential of SPI against Cd-exacerbated hepatic ischemic/reperfusion (I/R) injury in rats. METHODOLOGY: Forty male albino rats were apportioned into five groups including the sham, I/R induced, I/R + Cd (5 mg/kg), I/R + Cd (5 mg/kg) + SPI (50 mg/kg), and I/R + SPI (50 mg/kg) treated group. Gene expressions were quantified using qRT PCR. Biochemical assessments were performed using ELISA technique and standard assays. Results were cross validated through molecular simulation and molecular docking analysis. FINDINGS: It was revealed that Cd intoxication in I/R group downregulated the gene expression of silent information regulator sirtuin-1 (SIRT1), adenosine monophosphate-activated protein kinase (AMPK), mitochondrial transcription factor-A (TFAM), peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor-gamma coactivator 1-alpha (PGC-1alpha), and Estrogen-Related Receptor Alpha (ERRalpha) while upregulating the mRNA expressions of COX-2, TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-1beta, and NF-kappaB. Enzymatic potential of glutathione reductase (GSR), superoxide dismutase (SOD), glutathione reductase (GSR), catalase (CAT), heme-oxygenase-1 (HO-1), glutathione peroxidase (GPx), and concentration of glutathione (GSH) were suppressed while the levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and malondialdehyde (MDA) were upregulated following the Cd intoxication in I/R induced group. Cd intoxication in IR group escalated the levels of ALT, AST, ALP, and GGT while reducing the intensity of albumin and total protein. Moreover, I/R-induced and IR + Cd group showed upregulation in Bax, Caspase-3 and Caspase-9 while reducing the levels of Bcl-2. Severe histological impairments were observed in I/R as well as I/R + Cd treated group. Nonetheless, SPI therapy showed significant protection of hepatic tissues against I/R and I/R + Cd intoxication via regulating mitochondrial biogenesis, oxidative stress, inflammation, apoptosis and histological impairments. CONCLUSION: Cd intoxication escalates the hepatic ischemic injury via upregulating oxidative injury, inflammation and other key regulatory pathways. Spinacetin reversed I/R-mediated hepatic damage, demonstrating its potential hepatoprotective efficacy.
abstract_zh: 背景：镉（Cd）是一种强效环境毒物，可影响包括肝脏在内的多个身体器官。菠菜素（Spinacetin, SPI）是一种源自植物的多酚类化合物，具有多种生物活性。目的：本研究评估了SPI对镉加剧的大鼠肝脏缺血/再灌注（I/R）损伤的缓解潜力。方法：将四十只雄性白化大鼠分为五组，包括假手术组、I/R诱导组、I/R + Cd（5 mg/kg）组、I/R + Cd（5 mg/kg）+ SPI（50 mg/kg）组以及I/R + SPI（50 mg/kg）处理组。使用qRT-PCR定量基因表达，通过ELISA技术和标准测定法进行生化评估，并通过分子模拟和分子对接分析交叉验证结果。结果：研究发现，I/R组中镉中毒下调了沉默信息调节因子sirtuin-1（SIRT1）、腺苷酸活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）、线粒体转录因子A（TFAM）、过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ共激活因子1-α（PGC-1alpha）和雌激素相关受体α（ERRalpha）的基因表达，同时上调了COX-2、TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β和NF-κB的mRNA表达。在I/R诱导组中，镉中毒抑制了谷胱甘肽还原酶（GSR）、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、谷胱甘肽还原酶（GSR）、过氧化氢酶（CAT）、血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPx）的酶活性以及谷胱甘肽（GSH）浓度，同时上调了活性氧（ROS）和丙二醛（MDA）水平。I/R组中镉中毒升高了ALT、AST、ALP和GGT水平，同时降低了白蛋白和总蛋白的浓度。此外，I/R诱导组和I/R + Cd组显示Bax、Caspase-3和Caspase-9上调，而Bcl-2水平降低。在I/R和I/R + Cd处理组中观察到严重的组织学损伤。然而，SPI治疗通过调节线粒体生物发生、氧化应激、炎症、凋亡和组织学损伤，显著保护了肝组织免受I/R和I/R + Cd中毒的影响。结论：镉中毒通过上调氧化损伤、炎症和其他关键调控通路加剧了肝脏缺血性损伤。菠菜素逆转了I/R介导的肝脏损伤，展示了其潜在的保肝功效。
